summary.text: Alex Finkelman is a Democratic state representative who has represented Rhode Island House of Representatives District 74 since January 3, 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He owns the Egis Insurance Group.

paragraphs.text: Finkelman graduated from Providence Country Day School in East Providence and earned a B.S. in business administration, insurance, and finance from the University of Hartford in 2008.
His career includes owning the Egis Insurance Group, which specializes in insurance, consulting, and employee benefits, and he served on the Jamestown zoning board.
